/workspace/branches/76199332-384a-4571-81bc-e9762aff3529/replay_walsh.py and replay_walsh.txt: direct enumeration of all 2,016 coefficients at n=5 through 10, including the n=5 witness and computed gcds 1,2,2,4,1,2
correctness.rationale: The frozen version conflated the minimum 2-adic valuation with the minimum magnitude: at n=5 the empty coefficient is 5 but a singleton coefficient is 1, and the gcd is 1. Taking the empty frequency also left odd common factors unaddressed. The replacement distinguishes these facts and proves the full gcd: the exact ear profile A={1,n−1} has multiplicity one by inclusion–exclusion over the independent subsets of a path on L=n−5 vertices. The resulting coefficient of z^(L+1) in C(z(1−z)) is 1 since C(z(1−z))=1/(1−z) by the formal Catalan recurrence. Walsh inversion implies the gcd divides 2^n. The core theorem follows independently: prescribed independent ears can be cut off yielding C_(n−k−2) extensions (with n−k≥3), and the signed product expansion gives the stated Walsh identity. For N=n−1 the k≥2 prefactors have valuation k+s_2(N−k)−1≥s_2(N), by k−1≥s_2(k) and subadditivity. The singleton prefactor has valuation s_2(N−1), at least s_2(N) in odd polygon size and exactly s_2(N)−1 in even size. This proves both laws, and the character basis gives the asserted determinant and rank bounds. It also shows the already dyadic gcd has exact valuation v_n.
residual_risks: Finite tests corroborate counting and arithmetic; the proof is needed for all orders. No general even-order singularity verdict is asserted.

value.rationale: The natural short-diagonal observation sector admits all-frequency invertibility, even when the entire diagonal observation space can have cancellation. The higher-dyadic modulus settles the nontrivial infinite family of even Catalan counts beyond what unweighted parity or modulo four proves, and the even-order law gives a guaranteed nonzero half-spectrum without pretending to settle the rest.
residual_risks: No inverse norm estimate or all-even-order classification follows from the asserted valuations.
